# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 18 budget tracking tests pass on HEAD (master at 99c61dc): test_total_n_helper_sums_all_pools, test_total_c_helper_sums_all_pools, test_budget_component_labels_cover_all_element_bearing_fields, test_budget_path_rules_catch_convention_based_future_fields, test_closed_system_n_conservation, test_closed_system_c_conservation, test_periphyton_capacity_excess_routes_to_dissolved_organics, test_algae_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass, test_plant_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass, test_trim_plants_preserves_n_and_c_when_routed_to_detritus, test_clean_filter_routes_removed_microbes_to_dissolved_organics, test_closed_system_shrimp_mortality_conserves_n_and_c, test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c, test_water_change_n_export_tracked, test_water_change_tracks_gross_n_import_and_export, test_dissolved_oxygen_stage_tracks_gross_in_and_out, test_preset_dic_exchange_is_explicitly_tracked_without_disabling_carbon_guard, test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings passes with zero warnings on HEAD
- Acceptance criterion 1 (test can run N ticks and inspect per-tick budget deltas): BudgetLedger stores TickBudgetRecord with per-stage BudgetEntry deltas indexed by label. Tests like test_water_change_n_export_tracked inspect individual entries by label and verify in_mg/out_mg values. budget_ledger() returns Option<&BudgetLedger> for external inspection.
- Acceptance criterion 2 (closed-system ticks show near-zero net delta): test_closed_system_n_conservation and test_closed_system_c_conservation run 24 ticks with active biology (non-zero algae 0.35/0.55g, microbes 0.30g total, microfauna 0.4 index, detritus 1.15g total) and assert per-tick net deltas < 1e-6 plus total conservation < 1e-6. Runtime guard at engine.rs:524-549 returns SimError::BudgetImbalance for closed-system violations.
- Acceptance criterion 3 (zero-cost when disabled): budget_ledger is Option<BudgetLedger> (engine.rs:27), defaults to None. maybe_record_stage (engine.rs:250-269) only computes BudgetSnapshot when tick.is_some(). test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled verifies no allocation during 2 simulation steps when tracking is disabled.
- Canonical total_nitrogen_mg (budget.rs:341-346) sums 16 N-bearing components including substrate_layers[*].nutrient_store_mg_n_total per the reviewer correction. Canonical total_carbon_mg (budget.rs:348-353) sums 13 C-bearing components. Both built from the same component arrays used by the structural coverage test, ensuring single source of truth.
- TankState exposes total_nitrogen(), total_carbon(), budget_totals() (state.rs:241-251) all delegating to BudgetTotals::from_state() — single canonical definition point as required.
- Structural coverage guard (budget_tracking.rs:321-356) serializes TankState to JSON, discovers all numeric paths by convention (*_mg_n_total, *_mg_c_total, *biomass_g, detritus/animal patterns), and asserts exact equality with canonical helper component labels. Declaration-site doc comments (budget.rs:162-169, 260-267) document the naming-convention obligation.
- Carbon guard uses residual-based subtraction (engine.rs:577-582) to pardon known chemistry DIC exchange while still catching unrelated carbon leaks in the same tick. Nitrogen/carbon open-system classification requires both matching action label AND non-zero per-element flux (entry_has_open_action_flux at engine.rs:585-594), preventing no-op actions from suppressing the guard.
- Conservation fixes verified across all major pathways: TrimPlants uses plant_detrital_mass_g for stoichiometric conversion (engine.rs:348-360); shrimp mortality routes to detritus via route_dead_shrimp_to_detritus (shrimp.rs:507-517); shrimp hatch/maturation debits dissolved pools via fund_live_shrimp_biomass_from_water (shrimp.rs:535-566); CleanFilter routes removed biomass to dissolved organics (engine.rs:354-383); plant/algae loss clamped to available biomass; periphyton capacity overflow routed to dissolved organics; nitrifier growth reserves correct source pool (AOB/comammox→TAN, NOB→nitrite).
- Gross budget recording via from_snapshots (budget.rs:54-61) uses gross_element_budget (budget.rs:444-462) for per-component gain/loss decomposition. Explicit gross budgets for water_change and dissolved_oxygen provide separate in/out terms for bidirectional stages.
- All 6 acceptance-criteria tests from reviewer comments are present and passing: (1) test_total_n_helper_sums_all_pools, (2) test_total_c_helper_sums_all_pools, (3) test_closed_system_n_conservation, (4) test_closed_system_c_conservation, (5) test_water_change_n_export_tracked, (6) test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled.
- Per-stage recording covers all 12 PlayerAction variants via exhaustive match in action_budget_label (engine.rs:507-521) plus all hourly and daily system stages.
- Test helpers use manually defined stoichiometric functions with hardcoded constants (28.0, 35.0, 0.20, 0.12/0.05) independent of library helpers, providing genuine cross-validation of the stoichiometric math.
- docs/ROUTING.md updated to reflect CleanFilter's new closed-system routing semantics (routing removed microbe biomass to dissolved organics instead of exporting).

## Findings and Gaps

- One pre-existing test failure on HEAD: hatch_produces_juveniles in shrimp_population.rs. This is NOT caused by this bead's work — git log shows shrimp.rs and process.rs were modified by later beads (tanksim-6e5.3.2, tanksim-6e5.1.2.3) that changed shrimp metabolism parameters without updating this test. The shrimp_population.rs test file itself was last modified at our bead's round 2, but the underlying shrimp behavior changed in subsequent beads.
- The bead's checkpoint commit (4447cf7) does not compile in isolation due to missing ProcessParams fields (shrimp_assimilation_efficiency, etc.) that were added by a later bead (tanksim-6e5.3.2). This means the bead's work is interleaved with other beads on the same branch. On HEAD where all beads coexist, the budget tracking code compiles and passes all 18 tests cleanly.
- Convention-based field discovery in the structural coverage test catches *_mg_n_total, *_mg_c_total, *biomass_g, and shared patterns. A future element-bearing field with a non-standard suffix would evade detection. This is documented in declaration-site comments and is acceptable given Rust's lack of compile-time field introspection.
- Shrimp eggs remain implicit (EggCohort has count and progress_days only). Mass is conserved by debiting dissolved pools on hatch/maturation. A first-class egg biomass pool would be cleaner for save-schema clarity but is appropriately deferred.
- Complex multi-process stages like nitrogen_cycle record budgets via snapshot-derived gross component deltas. Same-component turnover within a single stage pass can net out. The explicit-budget path addresses the most important bidirectional stages (water_change, dissolved_oxygen, chemistry). Acceptable granularity for this phase.
- Oxygen tracking is limited to dissolved_oxygen_mg_total rather than decomposing O2 across biomass pools. Consistent with the deliverable's 'track where feasible' wording.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- The hatch_produces_juveniles test failure (shrimp_population.rs:117) should be investigated and fixed as part of the bead that caused it (tanksim-6e5.3.2 which modified shrimp metabolism parameters in process.rs). This is not a regression from this bead's budget-ledger work.
